title: Corey Phillips: Kitten Passphrase Puzzle

prize.note: 2 funding UTXOs summing to 1,001,900 sats, 0 spent as of 2026-08-16

addresses.label: sister (empty passphrase, oracle calibration only, not a target)

target_format: BIP39 24 words (fixed, public), unknown passphrase, BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/0

derivation.summary: hash the published image (base64 then SHA-256) to get fixed BIP39 entropy for a public 24-word mnemonic; the unknown passphrase plus the mnemonic derive the seed, then BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/0 gives the P2WPKH address
derivation.certified_against: the sister address bc1q57euh23y3qs2f9d5mtwpax5lqecfvrdkqce82a for an empty passphrase, and sha256(base64(kitten.jpeg)) matching the author's own published value

difficulty_note: the mnemonic and derivation are fully certified; about 1.16 billion passphrase candidates have been tested across curated, rule-mangled, and raw wordlist regions with 0 matches; the author states the puzzle is not meant to be solved, so the passphrase is a freely chosen secret with no confirmed public provenance

leads.title: safety-net derivation on BIP44 and BIP49

sources.title: Part 1/3: Turn Your Photos Into Bitcoin Private Keys/Addresses

third_party_material: clues/kitten.jpeg is the author-published puzzle image, byte-identical to the original, sha256 recorded in artifacts[]; no wordlists or third-party bulk data included, only my own derived candidate counts
